''See also: [[Naberius Clayborn Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Naberius Clayborn, also known as [[Lord]] Clayborn or the Witness, is a prominent figure within the [[Guild of Witnesses]]. A man of mixed heritage from [[Erin]] and [[Vandenyas]], he is a Chronicler who previously served as the keeper of the [[Imperial Palace treasury]]. He is described as having long, wavy dark brown hair and a penchant for high-quality, eye-catching attire, such as bright red suits. In his capacity as a Witness, he often travels with a [[Silent One]], specifically a mute woman named [[Tristania]]. Clayborn possesses extensive knowledge of government operations and maintains connections across various [[Guilds]]. He is a Reader with significant personal wealth, making him a highly influential individual. His role involves verifying historical truths and recording important events, though he has also been involved in high-stakes missions, such as attempting to retrieve the [[Heart of Nakothi]]. Throughout his history, he has been perceived as a heroic figure, though his obsession with the [[Heart of Nakothi]] led to claims that he was enthralled by it. While some reports suggested his death due to mental erosion caused by the Heart, others have noted his presence in political and maritime affairs, with some even speculating on his potential to ascend to the [[Imperial]] [[throne]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Naberius is a tall man with dark hair and a blindingly white grin. He has been seen wearing a red suit or a blue suit, and he carries a wound on his calf that is wrapped in a white bandage.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Naberius has been described as desperate while searching for the Heart and has shown a covetous nature toward it. He is a Reader with friends in every [[Guild]], though his mind was eventually eroded by the [[Heart of Nakothi]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a Reader, Naberius is capable of using his [[Intent]] to break ropes and can apply this power to the [[Heart of Nakothi]]. He is also a skilled navigator who utilizes a map and compass, and he possesses the ability to bond with the Heart for immortality.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Naberius Clayborn]] can bond with the [[Heart of Nakothi]] for immortality.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Naberius Clayborn]] is mentioned in relation to the Heart.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Naberius Clayborn]] was recovered by [[Navigator]] Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Captain Calder [[Marten]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Memories of the Witness}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Naberius possesses memories that have been wax-sealed.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 4</ref> The Witness responsible for [[Imperial]] finance maintains an association with candles.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" /> Furthermore, Naberius is an individual who would have declined the title of Emperor.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">3</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Naberius has wax-sealed memories.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Witness in charge of [[Imperial]] finance is associated with candles.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Naberius is a person who would not have accepted the title of Emperor.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[peace accords]] were written by a Witness.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref> These Witnesses exist in pairs, composed of a Chronicler and a [[Silent One]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref> During the events of this era, [[Shera]] was unable to kill Naberius Clayborn.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">3</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[peace accords]] were penned by [[the hand]] of a Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Witness.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Witnesses come in pairs consisting of a [[Silent One]] and a Chronicler.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Shera]] failed to kill [[Naberius Clayborn]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Witness report contained an accusation from [[Estyr]] regarding [[Calder]] being enthralled.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">1</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Witness report included [[Estyr]] accusing [[Calder]] of being enthralled.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I do not refer to your crew,” the Witness said grimly.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’m sorry, Mister Clayborn, but there will be a slight delay before we reach your destination.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“You’ve verified the Heart, then, Witness Clayborn.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|He called over to The Eternal. “Naberius!<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Urzaia, you and I will be headed over to The Eternal, where we will take Naberius hostage.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c17" />}}
